title: Organizations
description: Tenants onboarded onto this platform, each with their own admin and branch.

createForm.title: New organization
createForm.description: Onboard a new tenant with its first branch and administrator.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.description: Preferences of the organization that apply to all its branches.

numberFormat.label: Number format
numberFormat.hint: How quantities (kilos, units) are typed and shown. Peso amounts are not affected.

defaultCustomerPriceList.label: Default list for new customers
defaultCustomerPriceList.hint: New customers start on this price list; it can be changed customer by customer later.

country.label: Country
country.hint: The provinces and cities offered in forms are this country's.

paymentTerms.label: General payment term (days)
paymentTerms.hint: How many days a customer has to pay a sale on current account. It applies to every customer without a term of their own (set on the customer form). With 0 the sale is due the same day. Due dates and days overdue are computed from it.
paymentTerms.invalid: The general payment term must be a whole number from 0 to 365 days.

standingForm.title: Account standing
standingForm.description: Payment due date of {{name}} to the platform, grace days and suspension.
standingForm.statusActiveUntracked: In good standing · no due date set
standingForm.dueOnHint: To record a payment, set the next period’s due date. Empty: billing is not tracked.
standingForm.graceDaysHint: Days after the due date when everything keeps working, with a warning. Then web access is suspended.
standingForm.graceInvalid: Grace days must be a whole number from 0 to 90.
standingForm.reactivateDueOnInvalid: To reactivate, the due date must be today or later.
standingForm.suspendMessage: {{name}} will lose web access immediately. The point of sale keeps selling, with a warning. Continue?
standingForm.unableToLoad: Could not load the account standing.
standingForm.unableToSave: Could not save the account standing.
standingForm.suspendedButUnableToLoad: The organization is suspended, but its standing could not be reloaded.
